changelog:
- Initial release of report-helper for ClawHub, supporting automated, structured research reports and PDF generation.
- Triggered by user requests including "深度研究", "深入研究", or for product/company/concept/industry-related deep research or development reports.
- Interactive workflow with research scope alignment, information collection, self-audit checkpoints, and multiple working modes (interactive/auto).
- Fully local operation, respecting privacy and secure boundaries—no downloading dependencies or handling sensitive credentials.
- Output includes highly structured, source-cited PDF reports (1-3 million characters), with customizable authorship and format.
- Comprehensive instructions, configuration guidance, and clear audit logic provided in SKILL.md and references.
summary: 当用户说「深度研究 X」「深入研究 X」或要求生成某产品、公司、概念、人物、产业链、政策、趋势的深度研究/发展研究报告时触发，自动进行联网搜索和研究，产出排版后的 PDF 文档，总字数通常 1-3 万字。
